integrationsPage.pageDescription: Uniphore administrators can setup different integrations that connect with different elements of the Uniphore Platform, from streaming media to enterprise applications.
integrationsPage.ciscoCardDescription: Cisco is an on-prem contact center service or contact center as a service (CCaaS)
integrationsPage.ciscoCardHtml:
Cisco allows Uniphore to receive on behalf of customers:​
  • Real time audio streams for agent & caller​(both inbound and outbound calls)
  • Real time CTI Events and Metadata​

Customers can order VoiceStream SKU and configure in Cisco new Web Admin Console which partner(s) to integrate with and which calls to stream​.
integrationsPage.genesysCardDescription: Genesys is an on-prem contact center service or contact center as a service (CCaaS)
integrationsPage.genesysCardHtml:
Genesys allows Uniphore to receive on behalf of customers:​
  • Real time audio streams for agent & caller​(both inbound and outbound calls)
  • Real time CTI Events and Metadata​

Customers can order VoiceStream SKU and configure in Five9 new Web Admin Console which partner(s) to integrate with and which calls to stream​.
integrationsPage.avayaCardDescription: Avaya is an on-prem contact center service or contact center as a service (CCaaS)
integrationsPage.avayaCardHtml:
Avaya allows Uniphore to receive on behalf of customers:​
  • Real time audio streams for agent & caller​(both inbound and outbound calls)
  • Real time CTI Events and Metadata​

Customers can order VoiceStream SKU and configure in Avaya new Web Admin Console which partner(s) to integrate with and which calls to stream​.
integrationsPage.five9CardDescription: Five9 is a multi-tenant cloud contact center service or center as a service (CCaaS)
integrationsPage.five9CardHtml:
Five9 VoiceStream allows Uniphore to receive on behalf of customers:​
  • Real time audio streams for agent & caller​(both inbound and outbound calls)
  • Real time CTI Events and Metadata​

Customers can order VoiceStream SKU and configure in Five9 new Web Admin Console which partner(s) to integrate with and which calls to stream​.

Once on VoiceStream portal, select Uniphore as a Streaming Destination.
